decisions.decision: Mijoz va sartarosh uchun alohida akkaunt
missingImplementation: Role-separated registration/login and session destinations exist. Real PostgreSQL access checks, cross-role horizontal privilege boundaries and browser E2E remain unverified.
Logout clears browser session credentials and notifies other tabs; manually logging into another account uses existing login. Full browser/device revocation E2E is pending.

decisions.originalStatus: Qisman dalil bor, real DB tekshiruv kerak
missingImplementation: DB UNIQUE and phone canonicalization exist; real parallel sign-up and PostgreSQL uniqueness tests remain unrun.

decisions.originalStatus: Qisman: xavfsiz tiklash arizasi va Admin review qo‘shildi; real tasdiqlash va DB E2E qolgan
missingImplementation: Support case and Admin-review requests exist, but completed identity verification, credential/phone recovery workflow and live PostgreSQL/notification E2E are NOT implemented/verified. Admin status is not a credential reset.
Ommaviy profil/bookingda xarita pin-havolalari mavjud, koordinatasiz havola yo‘q. Haqiqiy marshrut hisobi, provayder URLlarining onlayn tekshiruvi, telefon qurilmalari va browser E2E bajarilmagan.
Haftalik ish vaqtini belgilash va nusxalash UI mavjud; real PG timezone, istisno kunlar va parallel bron konfliktlari to‘liq E2E qilinmagan.

decisions.originalStatus: Qisman: v11 narx quote tekshiruvi va bron snapshoti unit testlari o‘tgan; real PostgreSQL E2E qolgan
missingImplementation: Xizmat narxlari va bronning server quote/snapshot qoidalari kodda bor; full transaction/PostgreSQL E2E va narx o‘zgarganda barcha UI holatlari tasdiqlanmagan. Platformada onlayn to‘lov tasdiqlanmaydi.
